diagnostics.title: Git error details
diagnostics.policy: Local only. Logs contain timestamp, operation, exit code and category, never command arguments or output. No uploads. Up to five files of 2 MiB each. Raw output is kept only briefly in backend memory (up to 64 KiB).
diagnostics.warning: Raw Git output may contain passwords, tokens, remote URLs, paths and other secrets. Copy only if you intend to share it safely. Clipboard history and other applications may retain it. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
diagnostics.actionFailed: The action could not be completed.

reason.disabled: Logging is disabled by your setting.
reason.protection: Logging is disabled because protected storage could not be established or verified. The application can continue without logging.
reason.storage: Logging is disabled because local storage failed. The application can continue without logging.

category.unknown: Details omitted: this error could not be safely classified. You can retry, check repository status, or deliberately copy raw output after reading the warning.
category.authentication: Check your credentials and the remote access permissions, then retry.
category.network: Check your connection and whether the remote host is reachable, then retry.
category.locked: Another Git operation may hold the index lock. Wait for it to finish. Do not delete a lock while Git is running.
category.rejected: The remote rejected this operation. Fetch and inspect the remote branch before deciding how to continue.
category.timeout: Git exceeded the operation timeout. Check credential prompts and running Git processes before retrying.
category.cancelled: The operation was cancelled. Check repository status before retrying.

createUpstream.title: Create Upstream Branch?
createUpstream.description: Branch {{branch}} has no upstream. Push it to a remote branch with the same name and track it for future pushes and pulls?
createUpstream.noRemotes: No remotes configured. Add one using Manage Remotes before pushing.

pull.title: Reconcile divergent branches
pull.description: Your branch “{{branch}}” and its remote both have new commits. Choose how to combine them.
pull.mergeExplanation: Keep your existing commits and create a merge commit joining both histories.
pull.rebaseExplanation: Replay your local commits on top of the remote branch. This rewrites local commits and changes their IDs. Avoid rebasing commits you have already shared.
pull.once: This choice applies only to this pull. Your Git settings will not change. Cancel leaves your commits untouched.
pull.conflict: Pull stopped. Resolve conflicts in Changes, then continue or abort.
